blocks.text: some-, any-, no- + body / thing / where

O'zbek tilida noaniq kishi, narsa va joy `-dir` yoki «biror», «hech» bilan aytiladi: **kimdir**, **nimadir**, **qayerdadir**; **biror** kishi, **biror** joy; **hech kim**, **hech narsa**, **hech qayerda**. Ingliz tilida bu so'zlar ikki qismdan yasaladi: **some- / any- / no-** + **-body / -one** (kishi), **-thing** (narsa), **-where** (joy). Birinchi qism qoidasi sizga tanish: **some** — darak gap, **any** — savol va inkor (76-dars), **no** — tasdiq fe'l bilan inkor (77–78-darslar).

Kishi, narsa yoki joy bor, lekin u kim, nima, qayer ekanini bilmaymiz yoki aytmaymiz — **some-**: **Somebody** called. I've lost my keys **somewhere**. **somebody** va **someone** bir xil ma'noda. Fe'l birlikda turadi: **Someone is** waiting. So'zlashuvda bunday kishiga keyin **they** bilan qaytiladi: **Somebody** left **their** bag here.

items.text: I want to buy **something** for Madina's wedding.
Our hotel was **somewhere** near the old town.

blocks.text: Savol va inkorda: anybody, anything, anywhere

Savolda va inkor fe'ldan keyin — **any-**: Did you go **anywhere**? I didn't buy **anything**. Lekin taklif va iltimosda (javob «ha» bo'lishini kutsak) — **some-**: Would you like **something** to drink? Can I ask you **something**? Xuddi some/any dagi kabi (76-dars).

items.text: Did you go **anywhere** nice for your holiday?
Could you get me **something** from the chemist's?
items.translation: Dorixonadan menga **bir narsa** olib kela olasizmi?

blocks.text: O'zbekchada «**hech qayerga** bor**ma**dim» — ikki inkor. Inglizchada (78-darsdagidek) inkor bitta: yo fe'l inkorda + **anywhere**, yo fe'l tasdiqda + **nowhere**. «I didn't go nowhere» — xato. Bir gapda bir nechta noaniq so'z bo'lsa ham inkor bitta qoladi: He did**n't** tell **anybody anything**. — U **hech kimga hech narsa** de**ma**di.
something to eat, somewhere to stay

Bu so'zlardan keyin ko'pincha **to** + fe'l keladi: **something to eat** (yeydigan biror narsa), **somewhere to stay** (turadigan joy), **nothing to do** (qiladigan hech narsa), **nobody to talk to** (gaplashadigan hech kim). O'zbekchada bu `-digan` shakliga to'g'ri keladi.

O'zbekchada sifat otdan oldin turadi: **yangi** narsa, **tinch** joy. Bu so'zlar bilan esa inglizchada sifat **keyin** keladi: **something new**, **somewhere quiet**, **nothing special**, **somebody famous**. **else** (boshqa) ham shunday: **something else** — boshqa narsa, **somewhere else** — boshqa joy.

items.text: I need **somewhere quiet** to study before the exam.
items.translation: Imtihon oldidan o'qish uchun **tinch bir joy** kerak.

items.text: This café is full. Let's go **somewhere else**.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «interesting something» → **something interesting** (sifat keyin); «I didn't go nowhere.» → **I didn't go anywhere.** / **I went nowhere.**; «Somebody didn't come.» («hech kim kelmadi» ma'nosida) → **Nobody came.**; «Is there somebody at home?» (oddiy savol) → **Is there anybody at home?**; «I need a quiet somewhere» → **I need somewhere quiet.**
Eslab qolish: o'zbekcha `-dir` (kimdir, nimadir, qayerdadir) → **some-**; «biror» (savolda) → **any-**; «hech» → yo **not ... any-**, yo **no-**. Sifat esa doim keyin: something **new**.
Bog'liq darslar: **some / any** → 76-dars, **no / none** → 77-dars, **nobody / nothing** → 78-dars, **everybody / everything / everywhere** → 80-dars, **to** + fe'l → 52, 54-darslar.

rows: There's **nothing to do**. Let's go **somewhere quiet**.

examples.title: **somebody** / **someone** — kimdir
examples.description: Darak gapda noma'lum kishi haqida — **somebody** / **someone** (ikkalasi bir xil): **Somebody** is at the door. O'zbekchada — «kimdir», «bir kishi». Fe'l birlikda.

sentences.text: **Somebody** is knocking at the door.
**Someone** left an umbrella on the bus.
I think **somebody** took my pen.
Madina is talking to **someone** on the phone.
There's **somebody** in the garden — can you see him?
**Someone** from the bank called you this morning.
sentences.translation: Bugun ertalab bankdan **bir kishi** sizga qo'ng'iroq qildi.

sentences.text: We need **somebody** to help us with the move.
sentences.translation: Ko'chishda bizga yordam beradigan **biror kishi** kerak.

sentences.text: Aziz met **someone** interesting on the train to Samarkand.
sentences.translation: Aziz Samarqandga ketayotgan poyezdda **bir qiziq odam** bilan tanishdi.

sentences.text: Please ask **somebody** at reception — they will know.
I can hear **someone** singing in the flat upstairs.
sentences.translation: Yuqori qavatdagi kvartirada **kimdir** qo'shiq aytayotganini eshityapman.

examples.title: **something** — nimadir
examples.description: Noma'lum narsa haqida darak gapda — **something**: I've got **something** for you. O'zbekchada — «nimadir», «bir narsa».

sentences.text: I've got **something** for you — close your eyes!
sentences.translation: Sizga **bir narsa** olib keldim — ko'zingizni yuming!

sentences.text: **Something** smells good in the kitchen.
There's **something** in my eye.
Sarah wants to tell you **something** important.
Wait, I forgot **something** — my keys!
**Something** is wrong with the washing machine.
Bekzod bought **something** for his mother at the market.
Let's do **something** together this weekend.
sentences.translation: Shu dam olish kunlari birga **biror narsa** qilaylik.

sentences.text: I heard **something** strange outside last night.
sentences.translation: Kecha kechasi tashqarida **g'alati bir narsa** eshitdim.

sentences.text: When I opened the box, I found **something** wrapped in old newspaper.
sentences.translation: Qutini ochganimda, eski gazetaga o'ralgan **nimadir** topdim.

examples.title: **somewhere**, **anywhere**, **nowhere**
examples.description: Joy haqida: **somewhere** — qayerdadir (darak), **anywhere** — biror joyda / hech qayerda (savol, inkor), **nowhere** — hech qayerda (fe'l tasdiqda).

sentences.text: My glasses are **somewhere** in this room.
We'd like to go **somewhere** by the sea in August.
Are you going **anywhere** this summer?
I can't find my passport **anywhere**.
Tom lives **somewhere** near Manchester.
There's **nowhere** to park in the city centre.
sentences.translation: Shahar markazida mashina qo'yishga **hech qayerda joy yo'q**.

sentences.text: Did you go **anywhere** interesting at the weekend?
sentences.translation: Dam olish kunlari **biror qiziq joyga** bordingizmi?

sentences.text: The cat isn't **anywhere** in the house — maybe it's in the garden.
sentences.translation: Mushuk uyning **hech qayerida yo'q** — balki bog'dadir.

sentences.text: After the storm, the people of the village had **nowhere** to live.
sentences.translation: Bo'rondan keyin qishloq aholisining yashashga **hech qayeri qolmadi**.

sentences.text: I'd like to live **somewhere** far from the noise of the city.

examples.title: Questions and offers: **anything**? **something**?
examples.description: Oddiy savolda — **anybody / anything / anywhere**. Taklif va iltimosda (javob «ha» bo'lishini kutsak) — **something / somebody / somewhere**: Would you like **something** to drink?

sentences.text: Is there **anything** good at the cinema this weekend?
sentences.translation: Shu dam olish kunlari kinoteatrda **biror** yaxshi film bormi?

sentences.text: Would you like **something** to drink?
Did **anybody** see the accident?
Can I ask you **something**?
Have you been **anywhere** in Scotland?
Could **somebody** help me with these boxes, please?
sentences.translation: Iltimos, bu qutilarni ko'tarishga **kimdir** yordam bera oladimi?

sentences.text: Do you need **anything** from the supermarket?
Shall we go **somewhere** for lunch?
Did you meet **anyone** famous at the festival?
You look sad. Did **something** happen at work?

examples.title: One negative: not **anywhere** / **nowhere**
examples.description: O'zbekchada «**hech qayerga** bor**ma**dim» — ikki inkor. Inglizchada bittasi: I didn't go **anywhere** yoki I went **nowhere**. Bir nechta noaniq so'z bo'lsa ham inkor bitta.

sentences.text: I didn't go **anywhere** last weekend — I stayed at home.
sentences.translation: O'tgan dam olish kunlari **hech qayerga bormadim** — uyda qoldim.

sentences.text: This waiting room is full — there's **nowhere** to sit.
sentences.translation: Bu kutish zali to'la — o'tiradigan **hech qayer yo'q**.

sentences.text: Madina has never been **anywhere** outside Uzbekistan.
**Nobody** in the shop could help me.
sentences.translation: Do'konda menga **hech kim yordam bera olmadi**.

sentences.text: We didn't do **anything** special for my birthday.
sentences.translation: Tug'ilgan kunim uchun **hech qanday** alohida narsa **qilmadik**.

sentences.text: The children are **nowhere** to be seen — where did they go?
Aziz doesn't want to go **anywhere** without his dog.
In this small town there's **nothing** to do and **nowhere** to go in the evening.
sentences.translation: Bu kichik shaharchada kechqurun qiladigan **hech narsa**, boradigan **hech qayer yo'q**.

sentences.text: James didn't say **anything** to **anybody** about his new job.
sentences.translation: Jeyms yangi ishi haqida **hech kimga hech narsa demadi**.

sentences.text: Sarah is going **nowhere** until she finishes her homework!
sentences.translation: Sara uy vazifasini tugatmaguncha **hech qayerga bormaydi**!

examples.title: **something to eat**, **somewhere to stay**
examples.description: Bu so'zlardan keyin **to** + fe'l: **something to eat** (yegani biror narsa), **somewhere to stay** (turadigan joy), **nobody to talk to** (gaplashadigan hech kim). O'zbekchada — `-digan` shakli.

sentences.text: I'm hungry — let's buy **something to eat**.
We need **somewhere to stay** in London for three nights.
sentences.translation: Bizga Londonda uch kecha **turadigan joy** kerak.

sentences.text: Would you like **something to read** on the train?
I've got **nothing to wear** for the wedding!
Dilnoza needs **someone to help** her with English.
sentences.translation: Dilnozaga ingliz tilida **yordam beradigan biror kishi** kerak.

sentences.text: Have you got **anything to drink**? I'm really thirsty.
The old man was lonely — he had **nobody to talk to**.
sentences.translation: Chol yolg'iz edi — **gaplashadigan hech kimi yo'q** edi.

sentences.text: Let's find **somewhere to sit** — my feet hurt.
Bekzod didn't have **anything to write** with, so he borrowed my pen.
sentences.translation: Bekzodda **yozadigan hech narsa** yo'q edi, shuning uchun ruchkamni olib turdi.

sentences.text: When we arrived in Oxford, it was late and there was **nowhere to eat**.
sentences.translation: Oksfordga kelganimizda kech bo'lib qolgan edi, **ovqatlanadigan hech qayer** yo'q edi.

examples.title: **something new**, **nothing special**
examples.description: Sifat bu so'zlardan **keyin** keladi: **something new** (yangi narsa), **somebody famous** (mashhur kishi), **somewhere warm** (issiq joy). **else** ham shunday: **something else**. O'zbekchada esa sifat oldin.

sentences.text: Let's try **something new** for dinner tonight.
sentences.translation: Bugun kechki ovqatga **yangi bir narsa** tayyorlab ko'raylik.

sentences.text: Is there **anything interesting** in the newspaper today?
**Nothing special** happened at school today.
I'd like to live **somewhere warm**, like Spain.
sentences.translation: **Issiq bir joyda**, masalan, Ispaniyada yashashni xohlardim.

sentences.text: Madina met **someone famous** at the airport — a well-known singer.
sentences.translation: Madina aeroportda **mashhur bir odamni** uchratdi — taniqli qo'shiqchini.

sentences.text: Was there **anything wrong** with the room?
We stayed **somewhere cheap** near the station.
Tom bought **something expensive** for his wife's birthday.
sentences.translation: Tom xotinining tug'ilgan kuniga **qimmatbaho bir narsa** sotib oldi.

sentences.text: Would you like **something else** to drink — tea, maybe?
sentences.translation: Yana **boshqa biror narsa** ichasizmi — choy, masalan?

sentences.text: Aziz is looking for **somebody reliable** to work in his shop.
sentences.translation: Aziz do'konida ishlash uchun **ishonchli bir odam** qidiryapti.

examples.title: Mixed practice: some-, any-, no-
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: darakda **some-**, savol va inkorda **any-**, tasdiq fe'l bilan **no-**; **to** + fe'l va sifat bilan birikmalar.

sentences.text: **Somebody** phoned while you were out, but they didn't leave a message.
sentences.translation: Siz yo'qligingizda **kimdir** qo'ng'iroq qildi, lekin xabar qoldirmadi.

sentences.text: I'm bored — there's **nothing** to watch on TV.
Have you seen my phone **anywhere**?
Let's go **somewhere** different this summer — not Bukhara again!
sentences.translation: Shu yoz **boshqa biror joyga** boraylik — yana Buxoro emas!

sentences.text: Does **anybody** know the way to the station?
Sarah gave me **something** nice for my birthday — a book about Samarkand.
sentences.translation: Sara tug'ilgan kunimga **chiroyli bir narsa** sovg'a qildi — Samarqand haqidagi kitob.

sentences.text: **No-one** in our group has been **anywhere** in Asia before.
sentences.translation: Guruhimizdagi **hech kim** ilgari Osiyoning **hech qayerida bo'lmagan**.

sentences.text: Look, the lights are on — **someone** is at home.
Bekzod didn't buy **anything** in London — he says **nothing** was cheap there.
sentences.translation: Bekzod Londondan **hech narsa olmadi** — u yerda **hech narsa** arzon emas ekan, deydi.

sentences.text: Is there **anywhere** to buy fresh bread near here? — Yes, there's a bakery round the corner.
sentences.translation: Bu yaqinda yangi non oladigan **biror joy** bormi? — Ha, burchakda nonvoyxona bor.
